# SCENE｜Rainy Entryway
⟦BG|bg_c01s01|Rainy Entryway⟧
⟦TIME|New York · Night 1⟧
旁白：Five roommates turn around at once. Mason is holding a dry towel, Noah a bowl of hot soup. Elliot reaches out to block the rain blowing in, Theo quietly dims the lights, and Jace sets down his guitar. They're so in sync it looks rehearsed.
Mason：“You made it! Hug, high five, or absolutely no people for ten minutes?”
Noah：“He practiced that. I made soup instead.”
旁白：How you're welcomed is your call. If you don't want a hug, Mason will just smile, leave the towel on the table, and step back.
# CHOICE｜How do you want to be welcomed on your first night?
#### A｜Give Mason a hug
⟦OPT|A|set:c01s01_a⟧
#### B｜A high five is plenty
⟦OPT|B|set:c01s01_b⟧
#### C｜Take the towel and ask for ten quiet minutes
⟦OPT|C|set:c01s01_c⟧
#### D｜Why are they so in sync? Ask first
⟦OPT|D|set:c01s01_d⟧
# ·

# SCENE｜Shared Kitchen
⟦BG|bg_c01s02|Shared Kitchen⟧
⟦TIME|New York · Night 1⟧
旁白：Noah casually sets down a bowl in exactly the flavor you love. You've never told anyone. He laughs it off as a new menu test, but Mason nearly lets something slip.
Noah：“Tell me if I got it wrong. I can make something else.”
Mason：“Wait—weren’t we supposed to— never mind.”
旁白：You've never told anyone your favorite flavors. Noah says he saw them on the public move-in preference sheet—but you never filled one out.
⟦MG|m114_c01_g1⟧
# CHOICE｜What do you do with the soup?
#### A｜Take a sip and thank him
⟦OPT|A|set:c01s02_a⟧
#### B｜Ask how he knew what I like
⟦OPT|B|set:c01s02_b⟧
#### C｜Ask him to show me that preference sheet
⟦OPT|C|set:c01s02_c⟧
#### D｜Stare at Mason until he finishes his sentence
⟦OPT|D|set:c01s02_d⟧
# ·

# SCENE｜Living Room Window
⟦BG|bg_c01s03|Living Room Window⟧
⟦TIME|New York · Night 1⟧
旁白：Elliot hands you a separate lease summary that clearly says you have your own door key. Theo goes to share the house calendar—and finds a reminder for your move-in dated six months ago.
Elliot：“I should have checked the paperwork before you arrived.”
Theo：“That calendar entry is older than my account.”
旁白：Who added that reminder, and when? You can dig into it now, or save the evidence first.
⟦SET|plot_calendar_predated_move⟧

⟦OPT|C|set:c01s03_c⟧

⟦OPT|D|set:c01s03_d⟧

# SCENE｜Kitchen Through the Doorway
⟦BG|bg_c01s04|Kitchen Through the Doorway⟧
⟦TIME|New York · Night 1⟧
旁白：Late at night, you go for a glass of water and hear three of them arguing in low voices. Mason says they shouldn't be hiding things, Noah insists on telling the truth, and Elliot is worried about the letter that just arrived. You walk in. They don't run.
Mason：“We promised not to tell her yet.”
Noah：“She deserves to know.”
Elliot：“Not until we know who sent that letter.”
旁白：They admit something about your move-in feels off, but they don't have any proof yet.
⟦SET|plot_letter_received⟧

#### A｜Ask them straight out: what are you hiding?

⟦OPT|B|set:c01s04_b⟧

⟦OPT|C|set:c01s04_c⟧
#### D｜Ask to see the letter first
⟦OPT|D|set:c01s04_d⟧

# SCENE｜Morning Light in the Living Room
⟦BG|bg_c12s01|Morning Light in the Living Room⟧
⟦TIME|New York · Day 12⟧
旁白：The house receives the final, verified rental decision: you can sign a new lease of your own choosing, or move out—either way, you're free of the fake signature. Mason doesn't rush over to hug you. He asks first how you want to be welcomed today.
Mason：“Home again. Hug, coffee, or some peace and quiet?”
Elliot：“Whatever you pick, the light stays on.”
旁白：Where you live and who you love are decided separately.
⟦SET|plot_housing_options_confirmed⟧

# SCENE｜Celebration Breakfast
⟦BG|bg_c12s02|Celebration Breakfast⟧
⟦TIME|New York · Day 12⟧
旁白：Noah makes an ordinary breakfast—deliberately not your favorite, so it won't seem like he's still quietly keeping notes on you. Theo gives every tenant the power to reset the shared calendar permissions.
Noah：“I can cook you something new today.”
Theo：“You decide what we’re allowed to remember.”
旁白：These are house rules you all write together.
⟦MG|m114_c12_g1⟧

# SCENE｜Rooftop Confession
⟦BG|bg_c12s03|Rooftop Confession⟧
⟦TIME|New York · Day 12⟧
旁白：Each unfinished relationship opens up based on your choices: a one-on-one confession, a non-exclusive relationship everyone has agreed to, friendship, or staying independent. No one's love can take away your right to say no.
Elliot：“I want to be with you. I can finally say it clearly.”
Noah：“I’ll take the truth over a perfect answer.”
旁白：Whatever you choose, it only begins if everyone involved says yes.
⟦MG|m114_c12_g2⟧

⟦TIME|New York · Day 12⟧

Mason：“Can I say it one more time? Welcome home.”
Theo：“Only if she wants this to be home.”
